summary: A new tinybox build aimed at running the Kimi K3 frontier model locally. A follow-up diagram shows tinygrad driving the NVMe drives directly from the AMD GPUs, so weights that do not fit in GPU memory stream from disk.

appearances.summary: tinygrad is selling tinybox red kimi, a home system it says runs Kimi K3 at 40 tokens per second for $30,000. The box pairs 128 GB of GPU memory at 2.5 TB/s with 16 TB of storage that the AMD GPUs read through a tinygrad NVMe driver.
